positive_prompt: A sleek, modern awards ceremony programme background featuring a high-contrast black and gold color scheme. The design incorporates geometric patterns with subtle metallic accents, evoking a sense of luxury and sophistication. The composition includes soft gradients and refined textures, creating depth and visual interest. The atmosphere is elegant and premium, with a strong emphasis on clean lines and precise alignment, reflecting the theme of celebrating excellence.
negative_prompt: Avoid cluttered designs, overly bright colors, or any elements that detract from the premium and elegant aesthetic. Do not include any text, logos, or headshots in the background.
short_design_rationale: The design emphasizes a strong visual hierarchy with a high-contrast black and gold palette, aligning with the premium and elegant theme of the event. Geometric patterns and metallic accents add a contemporary touch, while soft gradients and refined textures create depth and sophistication. The layout ensures sufficient space around reserved content zones for clarity and readability.
